title: Test forms in U restrict to compactly supported continuous maps on the subspace U
statement: Let P, n, d ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set with the subspace topology (the subtype ↥U). Let f : Λⁿ(ℝ^P) → ℝ^d (Covector (Euclid P) n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) be continuous with f(0) = 0. Let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n): a C^∞ n-form on ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ U. Then there is g ∈ C_c(U, ℝ^d) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap ↥U (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) with g(x) = f(ω(x)) for every x ∈ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Covector (Euclid P) n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), Continuous f → f 0 = 0 → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, ∃ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap U (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ∀ x : U, g x = f ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)
